Shader.Category: Optional independent dielectric surface layer; defaults off.
Shader.Property: KKS five-region RGB encoding. UV0 with its own ST, linear clamp sampler. Not tiled with Texture2/3. Used only in KKS Regions mode.
KKS two-stage pattern: R appears over amount 0..1; G is added over 1..2 by max union. Both stages use cutoff and softness before region amounts. Linear data, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling.

Tangent normal, not height. Raw AG: X=A,Y=G numerical GPU samples. Exported AG PNG: inverse-sRGB G only, requires data sampling (sRGB off). Unity Normal: use an imported normal map. Own ST after LiquidTiling. Repeat/trilinear/aniso8.
XY is UV offset; ZW is tiling. Applied before each pattern, normal and custom coverage texture ST. KKS region mask keeps untiled UV0.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the R-max(G,B) front-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the G-max(R,B) front-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the B-max(R,G) back-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(R,G)-0.1)/0.9 back-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(G,B)-0.1)/0.9 face region.
Pigment RGB and opacity A. A=0 is a transparent wet film, not a disabled liquid layer. Pigment alpha never fades the wet normal or specular reflection and never cuts the mesh.
Pigment opacity multiplier. Combined with Color A inside the unified liquid coverage; zero preserves the substrate color and Toon lighting.
Scales decoded tangent slopes, then normalizes and smoothly limits tilt. It does not scale XY before reconstructing Z. Zero gives an unperturbed liquid surface over the substrate main normal.

Master strength for the entire liquid layer: coverage, pigment, normals and interface response. Zero leaves the dry material. Under wet coverage the liquid replaces the common Clearcoat interface, never stacks a second coat.
Liquid GGX direct/probe perceptual roughness. Independent of dry Toon specular, masks, regional skin gloss and Clearcoat roughness. Normal AA can broaden unresolved detail.
Fine normal influence on liquid pigment lighting only. Default zero. Never perturbs the substrate diffuse or its hard Toon shadow; wet reflections always use the liquid surface normal.
Artistic gain for the single liquid GGX direct/probe lobe. Zero hides reflected light, but does not disable pigment or interface transmission. Use Layer Strength to disable the entire layer.
Shader.Category: Unified coverage, independent pigment, stable normals and a single dielectric wet interface. LiquidX overlays already rendered surfaces; no GrabPass or volumetric water.
Shader.Property: 0 Raw AG; 1 Exported AG PNG (encoded RGB, numerical alpha; import as data); 2 Unity Normal. Explicit formats, not automatic detection. Never combine mode 1 with automatic sRGB decode. Keep game runtime sampling flags for mode 0.
0 KKS five regions and R/G stages; 1 custom mask R; 2 full surface. All liquid effects share the resulting coverage. Full Surface is suitable for independent water surfaces.
Custom coverage in R, linear data. Used in Custom Mask mode. LiquidTiling then its own ST, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling. Zero means no liquid.
Rejects low pattern/custom-mask values, then remaps the remainder. Does not clip the mesh or use Liquid Color A. Zero-coverage pixels are unchanged.
Smooth transition above the cutoff, augmented by pixel derivatives. Applied before KKS stage amounts so region animation remains continuous.
Smooth bound on decoded detail tilt in degrees, relative to the substrate main normal. Limits steep grazing ridges without changing roughness to hide decode errors.
Normal-variance specular anti-aliasing. Broadens unresolved high-frequency reflections. Zero disables variance broadening, not texture mip filtering.
Liquid interface refractive index, independent of common Clearcoat. 1.33 gives approximately 0.02 normal-incidence reflectance. 1 disables interface reflection. This is not screen-space refraction.
Independent gain for liquid reflection probes. Does not require the dry Reflection Mode or dry Reflection Mask. Base pass only; not duplicated by additional lights.
Mixes pigment soft lighting toward the substrate Toon visibility. Does not quantize liquid GGX or alter transparent-film substrate lighting.
0 final; 1 effective coverage; 2 coverage-masked world normal; 3 liquid direct specular; 4 liquid environment; 5 pigment opacity; 6 raw coverage before cleanup.

Substrate attenuation strength, default 0.25. 0 preserves the underlying lighting; 1 applies full approximate interface transmission and substrate index matching. Does not change liquid direct/probe highlights. Independent of pigment alpha. Low values are an artistic energy override. LiquidX applies the same view attenuation to framebuffer blending.

Liquid detail influence on the transmission normal, default 0. Zero uses the substrate main normal to prevent droplet slopes carving dark grooves into the underlying material. One uses full liquid detail. Reflections always retain full liquid normals. This is separate from LiquidDiffuseNormal for pigment shading.

Optional pigment shadow tint: RGB is a bounded multiplicative tint, A is its strength (default 0). Fades with Liquid Color A and Color Strength. Never tints a clear film, wet highlights or the dry substrate. Does not fill missing light, disable cast shadows, or control Fresnel attenuation; use LiquidEnergyBlend for that.

Main normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. 0 uses the mesh normal for this input; detail remains independently adjustable. Does not reduce specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid normals. Default 1. UseRamp=0 retains continuous lighting.

Detail normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. Independent of ToonNormalInfluence; default 1. Specular, environment and Clearcoat keep full normals. SkinX uses its existing SkinDiffuseNormalDetail instead.

Pixel-derivative filtering strength for procedural Toon bands and the diffuse geometric horizon. Default 1; 0 disables this extra AA, not texture filtering. Does not blur textures or remove large normal/compression blocks. Texture ramps retain their own sampler filtering.

Renamed from ToonDarkFillColor; the optional colored-fill calculation is unchanged. RGB multiplies albedo; A is strength, default 0, not coverage. Still respects physical cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting, not this color, to lift self-shadowed areas. Base-only, main-light-driven, off with UseRamp=0. Old game-card values under ToonDarkFillColor must be reapplied to this new property; no runtime migration plugin is included.

Minimum normalized main-light Toon diffuse response after the diffuse horizon and cast shadows: u becomes m+(1-m)*u. Default 0.15 provides a gentle shadow lift. Set 0 to disable; explicitly saved material values are preserved. Lifts both self and external shadows, not final RGB or GI; albedo, main light intensity/color, distance/cookie and material layer attenuation still apply. Base-only, no repeated Add lift, disabled with UseRamp=0. Does not change specular/coat/reflection lobes. Set ToonShadeColor A=0 when tuning this control alone.

Main-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights in Base/Add. Default 1 preserves the previous result; 0 flattens only this input, leaving detail independent. Selected-normal AA and light-facing guard follow this normal. Does not change diffuse, probes, MatCap, Clearcoat or liquid. Reuses existing samples.

Detail-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights, independent of the main normal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 removes detail from this layer only. Global NormalMapScale/DetailNormalMapScale still set source strengths. EyeX follows refracted iris normal samples; AA uses the pre-refraction surface footprint.

Main-normal influence on MatCap only, default 1. MatCapNormalSource remains authoritative: Geometry ignores both influences; MainNormal ignores detail; CombinedNormal uses both. Zero removes only the main-map input, not the independently enabled detail. Shared by additive and diffuse-multiplicative MatCap; no new texture fetch.

Independent detail-normal influence on MatCap when MatCapNormalSource=CombinedNormal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 keeps the selected main normal only. Ignored for Geometry/MainNormal sources. Does not affect direct specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid; EyeX uses refracted samples.

Shader.Property: KKS five-region RGB encoding. UV0 with its own ST, linear clamp sampler. Not tiled with Texture2/3. Used only in KKS Regions mode.
KKS two-stage pattern: R appears over amount 0..1; G is added over 1..2 by max union. Both stages use cutoff and softness before region amounts. Linear data, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling.

Tangent normal, not height. Raw AG: X=A,Y=G numerical GPU samples. Exported AG PNG: inverse-sRGB G only, requires data sampling (sRGB off). Unity Normal: use an imported normal map. Own ST after LiquidTiling. Repeat/trilinear/aniso8.
XY is UV offset; ZW is tiling. Applied before each pattern, normal and custom coverage texture ST. KKS region mask keeps untiled UV0.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the R-max(G,B) front-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the G-max(R,B) front-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the B-max(R,G) back-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(R,G)-0.1)/0.9 back-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(G,B)-0.1)/0.9 face region.
Pigment RGB and opacity A. A=0 is a transparent wet film, not a disabled liquid layer. Pigment alpha never fades the wet normal or specular reflection and never cuts the mesh.
Pigment opacity multiplier. Combined with Color A inside the unified liquid coverage; zero preserves the substrate color and Toon lighting.
Scales decoded tangent slopes, then normalizes and smoothly limits tilt. It does not scale XY before reconstructing Z. Zero gives an unperturbed liquid surface over the substrate main normal.

Master strength for the entire liquid layer: coverage, pigment, normals and interface response. Zero leaves the dry material. Under wet coverage the liquid replaces the common Clearcoat interface, never stacks a second coat.
Liquid GGX direct/probe perceptual roughness. Independent of dry Toon specular, masks, regional skin gloss and Clearcoat roughness. Normal AA can broaden unresolved detail.
Fine normal influence on liquid pigment lighting only. Default zero. Never perturbs the substrate diffuse or its hard Toon shadow; wet reflections always use the liquid surface normal.
Artistic gain for the single liquid GGX direct/probe lobe. Zero hides reflected light, but does not disable pigment or interface transmission. Use Layer Strength to disable the entire layer.
Shader.Category: Unified coverage, independent pigment, stable normals and a single dielectric wet interface. LiquidX overlays already rendered surfaces; no GrabPass or volumetric water.
Shader.Property: 0 Raw AG; 1 Exported AG PNG (encoded RGB, numerical alpha; import as data); 2 Unity Normal. Explicit formats, not automatic detection. Never combine mode 1 with automatic sRGB decode. Keep game runtime sampling flags for mode 0.
0 KKS five regions and R/G stages; 1 custom mask R; 2 full surface. All liquid effects share the resulting coverage. Full Surface is suitable for independent water surfaces.
Custom coverage in R, linear data. Used in Custom Mask mode. LiquidTiling then its own ST, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling. Zero means no liquid.
Rejects low pattern/custom-mask values, then remaps the remainder. Does not clip the mesh or use Liquid Color A. Zero-coverage pixels are unchanged.
Smooth transition above the cutoff, augmented by pixel derivatives. Applied before KKS stage amounts so region animation remains continuous.
Smooth bound on decoded detail tilt in degrees, relative to the substrate main normal. Limits steep grazing ridges without changing roughness to hide decode errors.
Normal-variance specular anti-aliasing. Broadens unresolved high-frequency reflections. Zero disables variance broadening, not texture mip filtering.
Liquid interface refractive index, independent of common Clearcoat. 1.33 gives approximately 0.02 normal-incidence reflectance. 1 disables interface reflection. This is not screen-space refraction.
Independent gain for liquid reflection probes. Does not require the dry Reflection Mode or dry Reflection Mask. Base pass only; not duplicated by additional lights.
Mixes pigment soft lighting toward the substrate Toon visibility. Does not quantize liquid GGX or alter transparent-film substrate lighting.
0 final; 1 effective coverage; 2 coverage-masked world normal; 3 liquid direct specular; 4 liquid environment; 5 pigment opacity; 6 raw coverage before cleanup.

Substrate attenuation strength, default 0.25. 0 preserves the underlying lighting; 1 applies full approximate interface transmission and substrate index matching. Does not change liquid direct/probe highlights. Independent of pigment alpha. Low values are an artistic energy override. LiquidX applies the same view attenuation to framebuffer blending.

Liquid detail influence on the transmission normal, default 0. Zero uses the substrate main normal to prevent droplet slopes carving dark grooves into the underlying material. One uses full liquid detail. Reflections always retain full liquid normals. This is separate from LiquidDiffuseNormal for pigment shading.

Optional pigment shadow tint: RGB is a bounded multiplicative tint, A is its strength (default 0). Fades with Liquid Color A and Color Strength. Never tints a clear film, wet highlights or the dry substrate. Does not fill missing light, disable cast shadows, or control Fresnel attenuation; use LiquidEnergyBlend for that.

Main normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. 0 uses the mesh normal for this input; detail remains independently adjustable. Does not reduce specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid normals. Default 1. UseRamp=0 retains continuous lighting.

Detail normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. Independent of ToonNormalInfluence; default 1. Specular, environment and Clearcoat keep full normals. SkinX uses its existing SkinDiffuseNormalDetail instead.

Pixel-derivative filtering strength for procedural Toon bands and the diffuse geometric horizon. Default 1; 0 disables this extra AA, not texture filtering. Does not blur textures or remove large normal/compression blocks. Texture ramps retain their own sampler filtering.

Renamed from ToonDarkFillColor; the optional colored-fill calculation is unchanged. RGB multiplies albedo; A is strength, default 0, not coverage. Still respects physical cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting, not this color, to lift self-shadowed areas. Base-only, main-light-driven, off with UseRamp=0. Old game-card values under ToonDarkFillColor must be reapplied to this new property; no runtime migration plugin is included.

Minimum normalized main-light Toon diffuse response after the diffuse horizon and cast shadows: u becomes m+(1-m)*u. Default 0.15 provides a gentle shadow lift. Set 0 to disable; explicitly saved material values are preserved. Lifts both self and external shadows, not final RGB or GI; albedo, main light intensity/color, distance/cookie and material layer attenuation still apply. Base-only, no repeated Add lift, disabled with UseRamp=0. Does not change specular/coat/reflection lobes. Set ToonShadeColor A=0 when tuning this control alone.

Main-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights in Base/Add. Default 1 preserves the previous result; 0 flattens only this input, leaving detail independent. Selected-normal AA and light-facing guard follow this normal. Does not change diffuse, probes, MatCap, Clearcoat or liquid. Reuses existing samples.

Detail-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights, independent of the main normal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 removes detail from this layer only. Global NormalMapScale/DetailNormalMapScale still set source strengths. EyeX follows refracted iris normal samples; AA uses the pre-refraction surface footprint.

Main-normal influence on MatCap only, default 1. MatCapNormalSource remains authoritative: Geometry ignores both influences; MainNormal ignores detail; CombinedNormal uses both. Zero removes only the main-map input, not the independently enabled detail. Shared by additive and diffuse-multiplicative MatCap; no new texture fetch.

Independent detail-normal influence on MatCap when MatCapNormalSource=CombinedNormal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 keeps the selected main normal only. Ignored for Geometry/MainNormal sources. Does not affect direct specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid; EyeX uses refracted samples.

0 fixed density; 1 screen-edge adaptive density, limited by TessellationFactor. Shared edges use endpoint positions only. No view-frustum/backface patch culling, so off-camera cast shadows are retained. This shader always has Hull/Domain stages; choose the ordinary shader to remove tessellation cost.

Maximum edge factor, clamped to 1..16. Default 4. Fixed mode uses this factor directly; ScreenEdge mode caps its pixel-length result. 1 does not disable the Hull/Domain stages. ForwardAdd repeats geometry work for each per-pixel light.

Desired screen-space edge length in pixels, 4..64, default 16. Only ScreenEdge mode. Lower values request denser geometry up to TessellationFactor. Adjacent patches agree on shared edges. Shadow-camera density may differ while using the same surface equation.

Independent Phong surface smoothing, default 0. Does not read the height map. GeometryMask R modulates it when enabled. It is not subdivision-surface reconstruction; hard-normal/UV seams or separate neck meshes require authored protection. Set 0 to preserve the original piecewise-linear surface.

Default off avoids geometry-mask fetches. Enable an independent linear UV0 RG mask: R Phong smoothing, G displacement. White allows the effect, black retains the source surface. It does not change diffuse, skin DetailMask semantics or mesh clipping.

Linear data, sRGB off. R smoothing and G displacement; B/A unused. Independent UV0 ST. Match values at welded UV edges, and fade R/G at neck joins or hard-normal boundaries. Not the KKS DetailMask, not a normal map. Uses Geometry Map Mip Level.

Linear R height, sRGB off, with independent UV0 ST. Height 0..1 is clamped; 0.5 is neutral at default midlevel. Carrier explicitly binds exact float neutral data. Alpha unused; GeometryMask G controls coverage. Does not reinterpret normal maps, liquid textures or eye parallax.

Signed world-space amplitude in Unity units, clamped to -0.05..0.05, default 0. Offset=(R-midlevel)*strength*GeometryMask.G along the interpolated world normal. Zero skips height sampling and normal reconstruction. No collider or CPU mesh-vertex deformation; bounds need the optional helper when expanding.

Zero-height reference, 0..1, default 0.5. Below it moves inward and above it outward for positive strength; negative strength reverses polarity. White therefore moves by (1-midlevel)*strength, not the full strength at default 0.5.

Explicit mip level, 0..8, used for height and geometry masks in Domain stages. Larger values smooth fine data; a mip chain is required. No automatic pixel derivatives or height-field ray search. Default 0.

Height-gradient correction of the interpolated shading normal/tangent, 0..1, default 1. Uses barycentric metric finite differences, including height/mask ST and world scale; zero preserves the source normal. Intended for shallow surfaces, not overhangs or physically exact large-deformation transport. Specular/MatCap controls still act on their own normal-map inputs.

Additional conservative world-space padding, 0..0.1, default 0. Used by optional TomTessellation.dll/component, not by GPU displacement. The helper also adds bounds for the actual smoothing/height controls, restores owned state on disable, and does not modify original shared meshes. Without it, Unity may cull shader-expanded surfaces using their original bounds.
Shader.Category: Independent linear RG geometry weights. Protect seams and separate mesh joins explicitly; no automatic vertex welding or changes to KKS mask meanings.
Shallow signed world-space height displacement in all geometry passes. Linear R data, explicit midlevel/mip, and independent normal correction.
Optional D3D11 geometric refinement. A separate shader entry preserves ordinary-shader draw cost. Density, Phong smoothing and height displacement are independent.
Optional CPU culling-bounds protection. The shader alone cannot change Unity Renderer bounds; no collision deformation.

Shader.Tooltip: D3D11 tessellated SkinX with identical inherited material/lighting controls, independent Phong smoothing and shallow height displacement. Ordinary SkinX remains free of tessellation stages. Bounds helper is optional but needed for reliable culling of expanded geometry.

Shader.Property: Skin color already composed by the game, followed by three overlays. Alpha is ignored unless SkinMainAlphaClip is on; clothing RG clipping stays independent.
Unity-imported tangent-space normal map. Affects lighting and reflection direction; use normal-map import, not color data.
Detail tangent-space normal combined with the main normal. MatCap can select a different normal source.
KKS clothing mask: R/G enabled by alpha_a/alpha_b, minimum coverage clipped at 0.5 in Base/Add/Outline/ShadowCaster. Independent ST.
Optional linear packed map: R metallic, G roughness, B AO, A direct specular mask. Enabled by UsePackedMaterialMap.
Linear RGBA masks: R secondary tone, G Rim, B MatCap, A environment reflection. White enables each layer.
Multiplies MainTex RGB. For metals this also colors F0; not a promise of unchanged diffuse color at Metallic 1.
Strength of the main tangent-space normal perturbation.
Game detail strength: scales detail normal, LineMask R line attenuation and B painted shade. SkinDiffuseNormalDetail reduces diffuse detail independently.
MainTex alpha threshold only when SkinMainAlphaClip is on. Clothing AlphaMask R/G always uses its separate fixed 0.5 threshold. Shared by Base/Add/Outline/ShadowCaster.
0 double-sided; 1 render back faces; 2 render front faces. ShadowCaster follows the same material face policy.
Texture-mode direct Toon transfer. Linear R is sampled horizontally at V=0.5. Ignored in procedural mode.
Optional secondary direct Toon transfer, sampled from R. Blended by SecondaryToneStrength times LayerMask R.
Enable Toon transfer for direct diffuse. Disabling it uses continuous diffuse; does not disable physical shadows.
0 procedural Toon transfer; 1 RampTex R. Secondary tone can modify either source.
Direct diffuse light/shade boundary in procedural mode. Not a shadow-map bias.
Width of the procedural Toon transition and its separate diffuse mesh-horizon fade. ToonAA supplies a pixel-scale minimum width. Does not soften normal textures, cast shadows, specular or Clearcoat.
Procedural ramp dark-end value before the mesh horizon and cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting for a controlled diffuse dark end after those restrictions, including self-shadowed backlit areas.
Blend toward SecondaryRamp, masked by LayerMask R. No legacy Fresnel coupling.

SkinX default 0: apply cast visibility outside the Toon ramp, preserving physical occlusion without an extra Toon threshold. Set 1 for the previous routing. Existing saved values are not migrated. For grazing-light striping, use Soft Shadows on the light; this material control does not filter the shadow map. ToonMinLighting remains 0.15.

RGB tint of Base indirect diffuse in main-light cast shadow. Independent painted skin shade uses SkinShadeColor at SkinShadeColorSource=1; compatibility mode 0 also follows this RGB. Alpha is unused. Does not tint each additional light, internal lines or ToonShadeColor.
Strength of main-shadow tint and direct diffuse shadow response. 0 relaxes artistic shadowing; 1 retains it.
Blend physical visibility toward the threshold/softness-shaped shadow response.
Boundary for optional shadow shaping; not geometry offset or light bias.
Transition width of optional shadow shaping.
Fallback material ambient color when LightProbeBlend is 0. Not reflection-probe brightness.
Main realtime direct diffuse and specular gain. Baked Subtractive main light remains owned by the lightmap.
Per-pixel ForwardAdd direct diffuse and specular gain. More lights still add energy.
Low-cost vertex diffuse fill gain. Vertex lights have no GGX, cookie or realtime shadow.
Blend fallback AmbientColor toward native SH/GI when not lightmapped. Does not control Reflection Probes.
Blend toward an available custom local SH volume. No effect without its external provider.

Indirect body illumination gain. Default 0.25 for a conservative start under bright Maker ambient lighting. Affects ambient/SH/lightmap diffuse, not direct lights, reflection specular or Clearcoat. Existing explicit material values are preserved.
Blend continuous indirect irradiance toward separate Toon shaping. Independent of the direct ramp.
Luminance threshold for indirect Toon shaping.
Transition width for indirect Toon shaping.
Dark-level output of indirect Toon shaping; near-zero irradiance still fades to black.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster slope offset. Default 0. Unity Light Bias and Normal Bias remain separate.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster depth offset. Default 0. Excessive offsets detach shadows.
Use MaterialMap RGBA instead of separate metallic, roughness, AO and direct specular-mask textures.
Linear R multiplier for Metallic. Ignored when the packed material map is enabled. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.
Linear R multiplier for Roughness, then RoughnessBias is added. Ignored in packed mode. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.

Linear R ambient occlusion; white is unoccluded. Affects indirect layers, not direct light. Ignored in packed mode. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.
Metal fraction. Removes diffuse and moves F0 toward base color; not an artistic reflection-strength slider.
Physical perceptual roughness. Controls continuous GGX and, optionally, reflection-probe blur. Toon highlight size is separate.
Offset after roughness map multiplication. Physical roughness is clamped to at least 0.04.
Advanced dielectric IOR converted to F0. Default 1.5. At Physical Diffuse Suppression 0 it does not suppress body diffuse.
Direct-specular Fresnel gain and optional diffuse energy suppression. Environment Fresnel and Rim are separate.
0 preserves Toon diffuse independently of Fresnel; 1 applies physical Fresnel suppression. Metallic always removes diffuse.
Geometric/shading horizon protection for specular, Clearcoat, liquid and continuous diffuse. Toon diffuse has its own single mesh-horizon fade controlled by ToonSoftness and ToonAA.
AO influence on indirect diffuse; also supplies AO to optional specular occlusion.
AO influence on environment reflection only. Does not darken direct specular.

Linear R direct-specular mask. Does not mask environment reflection, MatCap or Rim. Ignored in packed mode. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.
Direct-light specular tint only. Environment reflection has its own tint.
Direct-light specular gain only. Does not change the environment reflection layer.
Direct-specular shadow visibility influence. 1 respects occlusion; lowering it deliberately relaxes shadowing.
0 continuous production GGX; 1 normalized GGX-shaped Toon highlight. No Legacy Blinn path.
Artistic Toon highlight size. Separate from physical roughness; used by the stylized endpoint.
Threshold of normalized GGX highlight shape before multiplication by light intensity.
Softness of the direct Toon highlight boundary, with derivative-based anti-aliasing.
1 smooth Toon highlight; 2-4 quantize its transition into bands.
Normal-variance roughness filtering and Toon edge anti-aliasing. Does not eliminate every temporal aliasing source.
0 off; 1 MatCap; 2 environment; 3 both. Their intensities and masks remain independent.

Linear R shared reflection-region mask, multiplied by LayerMask B for MatCap or A for environment. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.
Environment reflection gain, evaluated once in Base. Does not change indirect diffuse.
Probe blur when UseMaterialRoughnessForEnvironment is 0.
1 uses mapped material roughness for probe blur; 0 uses EnvironmentRoughness.
Main-shadow influence on additive MatCap and environment. Multiply MatCap stays identical across Base/Add.
0 continuous HDR environment response; 1 bright-region-selected Toon response. Uniform environments cannot supply local bright features.
Luminance boundary for selecting environment highlights after Selection Exposure.
Softness of environment bright-region selection.
Scales luminance used for highlight selection; does not scale body ambient illumination.
In the Toon environment path, 0 neutralizes environment hue and 1 retains it.
Optional base-color tint of environment reflection. Metal F0 is already colored; high values can double-tint metals.
Environment-only angular Fresnel influence. Separate from artistic Rim and direct specular Fresnel.
Tint of both continuous and Toon environment reflection.
View-normal sampled color texture. Multiply uses twice the sampled color, so mid-gray is neutral; Add adds sampled color.

Continuous mix: 0 retains original Multiply, 1 retains original Add; intermediate values interpolate the two complete compositions, not two full-strength layers. Default 1. Multiply modulates diffuse in Base and every ForwardAdd; additive MatCap is Base-only. Existing saved 0/1 values keep their endpoint appearance. Previously fractional enum values now produce a real mix.
Multiply tint blend amount or additive gain, masked by ReflectionMask R and LayerMask B.

RGB multiplies the sampled MatCap color; default white. A (clamped 0..1, default 1) fades the entire MatCap effect back to no MatCap, independently of the existing intensity saturation and Multiply/Add mix. A=0 disables both contributions; it never changes mesh coverage, transparency, clipping, shadow casting, probes, direct specular or Clearcoat. Black RGB can darken Multiply and is not an off switch. Texture alpha remains unused.
Explicit MatCap mip level. Requires an imported mip chain to blur.

0 Geometry ignores both MatCap normal influences. 1 MainNormal applies MatCapNormalInfluence but ignores detail. 2 CombinedNormal applies main/detail influences independently. Defaults 1/1 reproduce the original selected source. Only MatCap changes; no scene reflection or direct-highlight modification.
Independent artistic rim tint.
Artistic rim gain, masked by LayerMask G. 0 disables Rim.
Main-shadow influence on Rim. Not additional-light shadowing.
Facing-angle extent of the rim. Independent of environment Fresnel.
Softness of the rim boundary.
0 view-only rim; 1 gates it by main-light geometric facing.
Linear R outline-width multiplier, vertex sampled.
Enable the inverted-hull outline. Layer debug views hide it.
Outline color.
Screen-space pixel-like width or world-space expansion using the shader scale convention.
1 screen-space width; 0 world-space expansion along normalized world normals.
Outline depth adjustment; positive moves away from the camera, accounting for reversed Z.
SkinX uses mesh normals only. UV4ObjectSpace is unavailable because the KKS third overlay occupies UV4. This option does not reinterpret those UVs.
RGB emission mask, multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity. SkinX UV0 atlas sampling shares MainTex filtering/wrap state with independent ST; match atlas import settings.
Emission tint, composed after the lighting layers.
Emission gain. 0 disables emission texture sampling.
1 multiplies emission by the evaluated base color; 0 leaves emission independent.
0 final; 1 body; 2 direct specular; 3 environment; 4 MatCap; 5 Rim; 6 emission. Fog and outline are hidden in layer views.
Neutral dielectric surface layer. Zero bypasses coating and preserves the original X lighting. Does not change alpha or stencil.
Perceptual coat roughness, independent of the substrate. Multiplied by coat-map G; floored at 0.04 and specular-filtered.
Coat reflection and layer-energy IOR only. 1 removes coat reflection. EyeX interior rays and dispersion use independent EyeRefractionIOR.
Linear data: R weight, G roughness multiplier; B/A ignored. Independent ST; shares MainTex filtering/wrap sampler state. White is neutral.
0 interpolated mesh normal; 1 main normal; 2 main plus detail; 3 independent coat normal. EyeX resolves this in the unwarped surface domain.
Unity tangent-space normal map, independent ST; shares NormalMap sampler state. Used only with normal source 3.
Strength of the independent coat normal. Does not modify substrate detail.
Coat reflection-probe strength. Independent of substrate ReflectionMode, reflection masks and environment tint.
Additional coat attenuation of diffuse body. 0 preserves Toon body brightness; 1 uses the layered approximation. Substrate specular attenuation is always applied.
0 final; 1 coat direct (Base+Add); 2 coat environment (Base only); 3 surface normal; 4 coat weight; 5 indirect body retention. Overrides Lighting Debug.
Shader.Category: Optional independent dielectric surface layer; defaults off.
Shader.Property: Linear KKS data: R painted highlight/specular gate; G painted shade; B Rim and Outline suppression; A skin versus nail/lip gloss region. Own ST and sampler. Not ORM. If genuinely missing, explicitly import bundled SkinDetailNeutral.png (RGBA 1,0,0,1). Empty runtime slots fall back to black, NOT neutral: R/A=0 can suppress highlight or select nail gloss. Preserve existing game/authored maps; no automatic replacement or size/content guessing.
Linear original channels: R internal lines, G game linewidth exponent, B painted detail shade; A unused. Shares DetailMask sampling state with independent ST.
Legacy face art data. G optionally blends diffuse normal toward the geometric normal through SkinFaceNormalStrength. B shadow bypass is deliberately not ported. Not a normal map.
Optional extra RGB color regions: sequential Col0 to Col1 by R, then Col2 by G, then Col3 by B. UV0 and MainTex sampler. Not the game texture compositor ColorMask.
Extra Base Tint. Extra color tint only; does not replace the game's baked MainTex customization.
Extra R Tint. Extra color tint only; does not replace the game's baked MainTex customization.
Extra G Tint. Extra color tint only; does not replace the game's baked MainTex customization.
Extra B Tint. Extra color tint only; does not replace the game's baked MainTex customization.
KKS nipple/lip layer on UV1 (Unity UV2), gated/remapped by vertex R and nip/nipsize. Ordinary RGBA or tex1mask legacy RG color encoding. Own sampler and ST.
KKS underhair/dynamic face blush on UV2 (Unity UV3) times vertex B. Tinted RGBA, applied after overlay 1. Own sampler and ST.
Third KKS RGBA layer on UV3 (Unity UV4), after overlay 2. Face eyeshadow; body role is asset-specific. Own sampler and ST.
Tint and alpha of the first KKS overlay. Default alpha zero is neutral; the game may replace this color.
Tint and alpha of the second KKS overlay. Face dynamic blush updates alpha at runtime; do not replace it with a static makeup bake.
Tint and alpha of the third KKS overlay. Default alpha zero is neutral.
Blend between ordinary UV1 and the localized nipple-size remapping; vertex R still gates both.
Legacy centered nipple remapping parameter, not ordinary texture tiling. Used when nip is nonzero.
Adds the legacy overlay-1 G painted shine inside its color encoding. This is not GGX roughness or Clearcoat.
Zero: ordinary tinted RGBA. One: legacy R colored shape with G painted shine. Texture/tint alpha still controls coverage.
Game clothing-mask R activation: zero bypasses R, one uses R. Never disables the G channel.
Game clothing-mask G activation: zero bypasses G, one uses G. Both active use the minimum.
Optional additional MainTex alpha cutoff. Clothing R/G clipping remains active regardless of this setting.
Game body/cheek gloss gain in the DetailMask A skin region. Runtime skinTuyaRate may update it. Does not alter roughness, IOR or coat.
Game nail/lip gloss gain in the 1-DetailMask A region. It is not limited to nail meshes.
Blend from unit gain to max(A*SpecularPower,(1-A)*SpecularPowerNail). Affects substrate direct/probe specular, not Clearcoat.
Multiply ordinary direct specular by stationary DetailMask R. Does not reinterpret R as roughness.
One bypasses the moving Detail R highlight mask. Zero permits it at SkinPatternStrength. Ordinary X specular remains available.
Legacy spelling retained. Moves painted Detail R lookup along tangent-space view using 0.8*(value-1). Not physical height, skin depth or refraction.
Moving Detail R gates the direct X highlight instead of adding an unlit legacy shine. Requires notusetexspecular below one. It remains per-light and shadowed.
Legacy internal line activation; affects diffuse body terms only, not outer shell width, coat or emission.
Independent gain for internal LineMask R/G after the game detail/linewidth calculation. No framebuffer-wide darkening.
Diffuse tint applied where internal lines attenuate the skin. Not the shell Outline color.
Blend line tint toward the game global LineColorG RGB. Game linewidthG still shapes LineMask G independently.
Strength of painted diffuse shade from Detail G and Line B. SkinShadeColorSource selects the tint. Independent of internal-line strength and shadow-map visibility; not AO/thickness.

0 follows ShadowColor for existing materials. 1 uses independent SkinShadeColor RGB for painted Detail G / Line B shade. Release carriers use 1 with the previous tint copied; saved game materials without this field retain 0. Does not change cast-shadow visibility.

Independent RGB tint for painted Detail G / Line B diffuse shade when SkinShadeColorSource=1. Alpha is unused; SkinShadeStrength owns strength. Does not tint specular, coat or liquid reflections. Not SkinLineColor or ToonShadeColor.

Existing skin diffuse detail control, reused by direct Toon shading without a duplicate slider. Reduces diffuse/SH detail while keeping specular and Clearcoat detail. ToonNormalInfluence separately controls the main normal in direct Toon shading.
New explicit art control: NormalMask G blends diffuse normal toward mesh normal. Default zero. Does not implement the old shadow floor.

Linear R soft-response coverage, G warm-transition coverage, B wetness coverage; A unused. Own ST, DetailMask sampler. Explicit neutral is RG=1 B=0: import bundled SkinControlNeutral.png only if missing. An empty runtime slot uses ShaderLab white, including B=1, NOT the carrier neutral; authored-wetness coat modes can then cover the full surface. No automatic binding/plugin; never replace an existing intended map.
Zero preserves the neutral X diffuse response. Positive values blend wrapped front-side diffuse and transition warmth under the skin control map. Not true SSS.
Broadens the diffuse lighting transition when SkinStrength is positive. Geometric back-facing surfaces and external blockers still reject direct light.
Warm tint amount near the light terminator; gated by skin strength, Control R/G and the lit diffuse contribution. No unshadowed red emission.
Width of the warm transition in diffuse NdotL, not world-space scattering distance.
Transition hue, luminance-normalized before blending. Independent of albedo and coat color.
KKS five-region RGB encoding. UV0 with its own ST, linear clamp sampler. Not tiled with Texture2/3. Used only in KKS Regions mode.
KKS two-stage pattern: R appears over amount 0..1; G is added over 1..2 by max union. Both stages use cutoff and softness before region amounts. Linear data, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling.

Tangent normal, not height. Raw AG: X=A,Y=G numerical GPU samples. Exported AG PNG: inverse-sRGB G only, requires data sampling (sRGB off). Unity Normal: use an imported normal map. Own ST after LiquidTiling. Repeat/trilinear/aniso8.
XY is UV offset; ZW is tiling. Applied before each pattern, normal and custom coverage texture ST. KKS region mask keeps untiled UV0.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the R-max(G,B) front-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the G-max(R,B) front-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the B-max(R,G) back-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(R,G)-0.1)/0.9 back-bottom region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(G,B)-0.1)/0.9 face region.
Pigment RGB and opacity A. A=0 is a transparent wet film, not a disabled liquid layer. Pigment alpha never fades the wet normal or specular reflection and never cuts the mesh.
Pigment opacity multiplier. Combined with Color A inside the unified liquid coverage; zero preserves the substrate color and Toon lighting.
Scales decoded tangent slopes, then normalizes and smoothly limits tilt. It does not scale XY before reconstructing Z. Zero gives an unperturbed liquid surface over the substrate main normal.

Master strength for the entire liquid layer: coverage, pigment, normals and interface response. Zero leaves the dry material. Under wet coverage the liquid replaces the common Clearcoat interface, never stacks a second coat.
Liquid GGX direct/probe perceptual roughness. Independent of dry Toon specular, masks, regional skin gloss and Clearcoat roughness. Normal AA can broaden unresolved detail.
0 common coat map only; 1 liquid; 2 authored wetness; 3 union. Multiplies existing coat weight/map. ClearCoat=0 always stays off.
Authored wetness gain times SkinControlMap B. Used only by wetness/union coat coverage; no pigment or geometry simulation.
Optional blend from the selected common coat normal toward the liquid normal under liquid coverage. Does not change the shared normal-source enum.

0 off; 1 albedo; 2 Detail RGB; 3 Line RGB; 4 liquid; 5 diffuse normal; 6 gloss; 7/8/9 UV1/2/3; 10 control; 11 clothing coverage; 12 liquid normal; 13 diffuse tint. Add/Outline suppressed for data views.
Shader.Category: Game-composed skin and UV1/2/3 overlays. Preserve game-owned textures, tints and vertex gates.
Independent clothing R/G cutout and optional MainTex alpha cutoff.
Legacy skin/nail gloss and painted highlight controls; separate from X roughness and Clearcoat.
Optional front-side diffuse softening, warmth and painted detail; not volumetric SSS.
Unified liquid coverage, independent pigment and a single dielectric wet interface. Shared with Opaque/Alpha/LiquidX.
Liquid/authored wetness coverage for the shared Clearcoat; ClearCoat must be enabled.
Shader.Property: Fine normal influence on liquid pigment lighting only. Default zero. Never perturbs the substrate diffuse or its hard Toon shadow; wet reflections always use the liquid surface normal.
Artistic gain for the single liquid GGX direct/probe lobe. Zero hides reflected light, but does not disable pigment or interface transmission. Use Layer Strength to disable the entire layer.

0 Raw AG; 1 Exported AG PNG (encoded RGB, numerical alpha; import as data); 2 Unity Normal. Explicit formats, not automatic detection. Never combine mode 1 with automatic sRGB decode. Keep game runtime sampling flags for mode 0.
0 KKS five regions and R/G stages; 1 custom mask R; 2 full surface. All liquid effects share the resulting coverage. Full Surface is suitable for independent water surfaces.
Custom coverage in R, linear data. Used in Custom Mask mode. LiquidTiling then its own ST, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling. Zero means no liquid.
Rejects low pattern/custom-mask values, then remaps the remainder. Does not clip the mesh or use Liquid Color A. Zero-coverage pixels are unchanged.
Smooth transition above the cutoff, augmented by pixel derivatives. Applied before KKS stage amounts so region animation remains continuous.
Smooth bound on decoded detail tilt in degrees, relative to the substrate main normal. Limits steep grazing ridges without changing roughness to hide decode errors.
Normal-variance specular anti-aliasing. Broadens unresolved high-frequency reflections. Zero disables variance broadening, not texture mip filtering.
Liquid interface refractive index, independent of common Clearcoat. 1.33 gives approximately 0.02 normal-incidence reflectance. 1 disables interface reflection. This is not screen-space refraction.
Independent gain for liquid reflection probes. Does not require the dry Reflection Mode or dry Reflection Mask. Base pass only; not duplicated by additional lights.
Mixes pigment soft lighting toward the substrate Toon visibility. Does not quantize liquid GGX or alter transparent-film substrate lighting.
0 final; 1 effective coverage; 2 coverage-masked world normal; 3 liquid direct specular; 4 liquid environment; 5 pigment opacity; 6 raw coverage before cleanup.

Substrate attenuation strength, default 0.25. 0 preserves the underlying lighting; 1 applies full approximate interface transmission and substrate index matching. Does not change liquid direct/probe highlights. Independent of pigment alpha. Low values are an artistic energy override. LiquidX applies the same view attenuation to framebuffer blending.

Liquid detail influence on the transmission normal, default 0. Zero uses the substrate main normal to prevent droplet slopes carving dark grooves into the underlying material. One uses full liquid detail. Reflections always retain full liquid normals. This is separate from LiquidDiffuseNormal for pigment shading.

Optional pigment shadow tint: RGB is a bounded multiplicative tint, A is its strength (default 0). Fades with Liquid Color A and Color Strength. Never tints a clear film, wet highlights or the dry substrate. Does not fill missing light, disable cast shadows, or control Fresnel attenuation; use LiquidEnergyBlend for that.

Main normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. 0 uses the mesh normal for this input; detail remains independently adjustable. Does not reduce specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid normals. Default 1. UseRamp=0 retains continuous lighting.

Pixel-derivative filtering strength for procedural Toon bands and the diffuse geometric horizon. Default 1; 0 disables this extra AA, not texture filtering. Does not blur textures or remove large normal/compression blocks. Texture ramps retain their own sampler filtering.

Renamed from ToonDarkFillColor; the optional colored-fill calculation is unchanged. RGB multiplies albedo; A is strength, default 0, not coverage. Still respects physical cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting, not this color, to lift self-shadowed areas. Base-only, main-light-driven, off with UseRamp=0. Old game-card values under ToonDarkFillColor must be reapplied to this new property; no runtime migration plugin is included.

Minimum normalized main-light Toon diffuse response after the diffuse horizon and cast shadows: u becomes m+(1-m)*u. Default 0.15 provides a gentle shadow lift. Set 0 to disable; explicitly saved material values are preserved. Lifts both self and external shadows, not final RGB or GI; albedo, main light intensity/color, distance/cookie and material layer attenuation still apply. Base-only, no repeated Add lift, disabled with UseRamp=0. Does not change specular/coat/reflection lobes. Set ToonShadeColor A=0 when tuning this control alone.

Default off. With UseRamp enabled, replace direct Toon diffuse in FaceSDFMask regions using an authored face threshold map. Real cast shadows, specular, SH, coat and liquid normals remain independent. Body materials stay off.

Independent linear UV0 threshold data, sRGB off; not DetailMask or a normal map. Bilinear/clamp sampler shared with liquid region data, independent ST. Higher values stay lit longer. Check the asset encoding before enabling.

Independent linear R region mask on unmirrored UV0 with its own ST. White applies SDF; black restores ordinary Toon. Default white covers the whole material; exclude ears/back/head or use separate face material. Does not clip geometry.
0 restores ordinary Toon; 1 fully replaces its normal-driven diffuse boundary inside FaceSDFMask. Global UseRamp still gates SDF. Does not blend specular or shadow-map visibility.
0 R, 1 G, 2 B, 3 A. Used in Single/MirrorU modes. RGPair uses R/G regardless of this setting; threshold data must be imported without sRGB conversion.

0 Single: selected channel for both sides. 1 MirrorU: when light is on head-left, mirror texture U about FaceSDFMirrorU after SDF ST. 2 RGPair: R for head-right, G for head-left, no mirror. Forward/Up define the head frame.
Texture-space mirror center after FaceSDFTex ST, default 0.5. Used only by MirrorU. It does not move the region mask or skin color UV.
Invert selected threshold data (1-value). Use for maps whose polarity is opposite to the higher-value-stays-lit contract. Region mask is unaffected.
0 Cosine: threshold=(1-frontCosine)/2. 1 Angular: threshold=abs(head-relative azimuth)/180 degrees. Front is 0, side is 0.5, back is 1. This is an encoding choice, not brightness.
Signed light-threshold offset. Positive expands the shaded region, negative expands the lit region. Default 0; does not change cast shadows or ToonMinLighting.

Width in threshold-data units, default 0.03. ToonAA supplies a pixel-derivative minimum width. Existing Toon ramp endpoints define dark/light levels; SDF supplies their blend, not a second normal threshold.

0 renderer object axes. 1 tracked head axes from optional TomSkinSDF.dll/component; without valid provider data falls back to renderer axes. Skinned head turns require the provider. No globals shared between characters.
XYZ local head/renderer forward, default +Z; W unused. Not an RGBA tint. Use (0,0,-1,0) for -Z faces. Tracked mode interprets this in head-bone local space.
XYZ local up, default +Y; W unused. Orthogonalized against Forward, with a safe fallback for zero/parallel vectors. Together they define right as cross(up,forward).

0 final, 1 effective SDF region weight, 2 selected map times region, 3 main-light lit region before cast shadows. Enable UseFaceSDF and UseRamp. Data views suppress Add/Outline/fog; alpha and caster coverage stay intact.
Shader.Category: Optional authored face Toon boundaries. Independent UV0 map/region and head-relative light direction; does not replace real cast shadows. Tracked skinned heads use the optional head provider.
Shader.Property: Main-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights in Base/Add. Default 1 preserves the previous result; 0 flattens only this input, leaving detail independent. Selected-normal AA and light-facing guard follow this normal. Does not change diffuse, probes, MatCap, Clearcoat or liquid. Reuses existing samples.

Detail-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights, independent of the main normal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 removes detail from this layer only. Global NormalMapScale/DetailNormalMapScale still set source strengths. EyeX follows refracted iris normal samples; AA uses the pre-refraction surface footprint.

Main-normal influence on MatCap only, default 1. MatCapNormalSource remains authoritative: Geometry ignores both influences; MainNormal ignores detail; CombinedNormal uses both. Zero removes only the main-map input, not the independently enabled detail. Shared by additive and diffuse-multiplicative MatCap; no new texture fetch.

Independent detail-normal influence on MatCap when MatCapNormalSource=CombinedNormal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 keeps the selected main normal only. Ignored for Geometry/MainNormal sources. Does not affect direct specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid; EyeX uses refracted samples.

0 fixed density; 1 screen-edge adaptive density, limited by TessellationFactor. Shared edges use endpoint positions only. No view-frustum/backface patch culling, so off-camera cast shadows are retained. This shader always has Hull/Domain stages; choose the ordinary shader to remove tessellation cost.

Maximum edge factor, clamped to 1..16. Default 4. Fixed mode uses this factor directly; ScreenEdge mode caps its pixel-length result. 1 does not disable the Hull/Domain stages. ForwardAdd repeats geometry work for each per-pixel light.

Desired screen-space edge length in pixels, 4..64, default 16. Only ScreenEdge mode. Lower values request denser geometry up to TessellationFactor. Adjacent patches agree on shared edges. Shadow-camera density may differ while using the same surface equation.

Independent Phong surface smoothing, default 0. Does not read the height map. GeometryMask R modulates it when enabled. It is not subdivision-surface reconstruction; hard-normal/UV seams or separate neck meshes require authored protection. Set 0 to preserve the original piecewise-linear surface.

Default off avoids geometry-mask fetches. Enable an independent linear UV0 RG mask: R Phong smoothing, G displacement. White allows the effect, black retains the source surface. It does not change diffuse, skin DetailMask semantics or mesh clipping.

Linear data, sRGB off. R smoothing and G displacement; B/A unused. Independent UV0 ST. Match values at welded UV edges, and fade R/G at neck joins or hard-normal boundaries. Not the KKS DetailMask, not a normal map. Uses Geometry Map Mip Level.

Linear R height, sRGB off, with independent UV0 ST. Height 0..1 is clamped; 0.5 is neutral at default midlevel. Carrier explicitly binds exact float neutral data. Alpha unused; GeometryMask G controls coverage. Does not reinterpret normal maps, liquid textures or eye parallax.

Signed world-space amplitude in Unity units, clamped to -0.05..0.05, default 0. Offset=(R-midlevel)*strength*GeometryMask.G along the interpolated world normal. Zero skips height sampling and normal reconstruction. No collider or CPU mesh-vertex deformation; bounds need the optional helper when expanding.

Zero-height reference, 0..1, default 0.5. Below it moves inward and above it outward for positive strength; negative strength reverses polarity. White therefore moves by (1-midlevel)*strength, not the full strength at default 0.5.

Explicit mip level, 0..8, used for height and geometry masks in Domain stages. Larger values smooth fine data; a mip chain is required. No automatic pixel derivatives or height-field ray search. Default 0.

Height-gradient correction of the interpolated shading normal/tangent, 0..1, default 1. Uses barycentric metric finite differences, including height/mask ST and world scale; zero preserves the source normal. Intended for shallow surfaces, not overhangs or physically exact large-deformation transport. Specular/MatCap controls still act on their own normal-map inputs.

Additional conservative world-space padding, 0..0.1, default 0. Used by optional TomTessellation.dll/component, not by GPU displacement. The helper also adds bounds for the actual smoothing/height controls, restores owned state on disable, and does not modify original shared meshes. Without it, Unity may cull shader-expanded surfaces using their original bounds.
Shader.Category: Independent linear RG geometry weights. Protect seams and separate mesh joins explicitly; no automatic vertex welding or changes to KKS mask meanings.
Shallow signed world-space height displacement in all geometry passes. Linear R data, explicit midlevel/mip, and independent normal correction.
Optional D3D11 geometric refinement. A separate shader entry preserves ordinary-shader draw cost. Density, Phong smoothing and height displacement are independent.
Optional CPU culling-bounds protection. The shader alone cannot change Unity Renderer bounds; no collision deformation.

Shader.Property: Main RGB is straight (not premultiplied) color. Main alpha times AlphaMask R times Alpha is final surface coverage.
Unity-imported tangent-space normal map. Affects lighting and reflection direction; use normal-map import, not color data.
Detail tangent-space normal combined with the main normal. MatCap can select a different normal source.
Linear R coverage mask, multiplied by MainTex alpha and global Alpha in every pass.
Optional linear packed map: R metallic, G roughness, B AO, A direct specular mask. Enabled by UsePackedMaterialMap.
Linear RGBA masks: R secondary tone, G Rim, B MatCap, A environment reflection. White enables each layer.
Multiplies MainTex RGB. For metals this also colors F0; not a promise of unchanged diffuse color at Metallic 1.
Strength of the main tangent-space normal perturbation.
Strength of the detail tangent-space normal perturbation.
Global coverage threshold, used only when AlphaOptionCutoff is 1. Rejected pixels produce no body, outline, depth or shadow. Coverage zero is always discarded.
0 double-sided; 1 render back faces; 2 render front faces. ShadowCaster follows the same material face policy.
Texture-mode direct Toon transfer. Linear R is sampled horizontally at V=0.5. Ignored in procedural mode.
Optional secondary direct Toon transfer, sampled from R. Blended by SecondaryToneStrength times LayerMask R.
Enable Toon transfer for direct diffuse. Disabling it uses continuous diffuse; does not disable physical shadows.
0 procedural Toon transfer; 1 RampTex R. Secondary tone can modify either source.
Direct diffuse light/shade boundary in procedural mode. Not a shadow-map bias.
Width of the procedural Toon transition and its separate diffuse mesh-horizon fade. ToonAA supplies a pixel-scale minimum width. Does not soften normal textures, cast shadows, specular or Clearcoat.
Procedural ramp dark-end value before the mesh horizon and cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting for a controlled diffuse dark end after those restrictions, including self-shadowed backlit areas.
Blend toward SecondaryRamp, masked by LayerMask R. No legacy Fresnel coupling.
Include artistic shadow visibility in the direct ramp input. Visibility is also retained outside the ramp.
Tint of the Base indirect body in main-light shadow. Does not tint every additional light separately.
Strength of main-shadow tint and direct diffuse shadow response. 0 relaxes artistic shadowing; 1 retains it.
Blend physical visibility toward the threshold/softness-shaped shadow response.
Boundary for optional shadow shaping; not geometry offset or light bias.
Transition width of optional shadow shaping.
Fallback material ambient color when LightProbeBlend is 0. Not reflection-probe brightness.
Main realtime direct diffuse and specular gain. Baked Subtractive main light remains owned by the lightmap.
Per-pixel ForwardAdd direct diffuse and specular gain. More lights still add energy.
Low-cost vertex diffuse fill gain. Vertex lights have no GGX, cookie or realtime shadow.
Blend fallback AmbientColor toward native SH/GI when not lightmapped. Does not control Reflection Probes.
Blend toward an available custom local SH volume. No effect without its external provider.

Indirect body illumination gain. Default 0.25 for a conservative start under bright Maker ambient lighting. Affects ambient/SH/lightmap diffuse, not direct lights, reflection specular or Clearcoat. Existing explicit material values are preserved.
Blend continuous indirect irradiance toward separate Toon shaping. Independent of the direct ramp.
Luminance threshold for indirect Toon shaping.
Transition width for indirect Toon shaping.
Dark-level output of indirect Toon shaping; near-zero irradiance still fades to black.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster slope offset. Default 0. Unity Light Bias and Normal Bias remain separate.
Advanced ShadowCaster raster depth offset. Default 0. Excessive offsets detach shadows.
Use MaterialMap RGBA instead of separate metallic, roughness, AO and direct specular-mask textures.
Linear R multiplier for Metallic. Ignored when the packed material map is enabled.
Linear R multiplier for Roughness, then RoughnessBias is added. Ignored in packed mode.
Linear R ambient occlusion; white is unoccluded. Affects indirect layers, not direct light. Ignored in packed mode.
Metal fraction. Removes diffuse and moves F0 toward base color; not an artistic reflection-strength slider.
Physical perceptual roughness. Controls continuous GGX and, optionally, reflection-probe blur. Toon highlight size is separate.
Offset after roughness map multiplication. Physical roughness is clamped to at least 0.04.
Advanced dielectric IOR converted to F0. Default 1.5. At Physical Diffuse Suppression 0 it does not suppress body diffuse.
Direct-specular Fresnel gain and optional diffuse energy suppression. Environment Fresnel and Rim are separate.
0 preserves Toon diffuse independently of Fresnel; 1 applies physical Fresnel suppression. Metallic always removes diffuse.
Geometric/shading horizon protection for specular, Clearcoat, liquid and continuous diffuse. Toon diffuse has its own single mesh-horizon fade controlled by ToonSoftness and ToonAA.
AO influence on indirect diffuse; also supplies AO to optional specular occlusion.
AO influence on environment reflection only. Does not darken direct specular.
Linear R direct-specular mask. Does not mask environment reflection, MatCap or Rim. Ignored in packed mode.
Direct-light specular tint only. Environment reflection has its own tint.
Direct-light specular gain only. Does not change the environment reflection layer.
Direct-specular shadow visibility influence. 1 respects occlusion; lowering it deliberately relaxes shadowing.
0 continuous production GGX; 1 normalized GGX-shaped Toon highlight. No Legacy Blinn path.
Artistic Toon highlight size. Separate from physical roughness; used by the stylized endpoint.
Threshold of normalized GGX highlight shape before multiplication by light intensity.
Softness of the direct Toon highlight boundary, with derivative-based anti-aliasing.
1 smooth Toon highlight; 2-4 quantize its transition into bands.
Normal-variance roughness filtering and Toon edge anti-aliasing. Does not eliminate every temporal aliasing source.
0 off; 1 MatCap; 2 environment; 3 both. Their intensities and masks remain independent.
Linear R shared reflection-region mask, multiplied by LayerMask B for MatCap or A for environment.
Environment reflection gain, evaluated once in Base. Does not change indirect diffuse.
Probe blur when UseMaterialRoughnessForEnvironment is 0.
1 uses mapped material roughness for probe blur; 0 uses EnvironmentRoughness.
Main-shadow influence on additive MatCap and environment. Multiply MatCap stays identical across Base/Add.
0 continuous HDR environment response; 1 bright-region-selected Toon response. Uniform environments cannot supply local bright features.
Luminance boundary for selecting environment highlights after Selection Exposure.
Softness of environment bright-region selection.
Scales luminance used for highlight selection; does not scale body ambient illumination.
In the Toon environment path, 0 neutralizes environment hue and 1 retains it.
Optional base-color tint of environment reflection. Metal F0 is already colored; high values can double-tint metals.
Environment-only angular Fresnel influence. Separate from artistic Rim and direct specular Fresnel.
Tint of both continuous and Toon environment reflection.
View-normal sampled color texture. Multiply uses twice the sampled color, so mid-gray is neutral; Add adds sampled color.

Continuous mix: 0 retains original Multiply, 1 retains original Add; intermediate values interpolate the two complete compositions, not two full-strength layers. Default 1. Multiply modulates diffuse in Base and every ForwardAdd; additive MatCap is Base-only. Existing saved 0/1 values keep their endpoint appearance. Previously fractional enum values now produce a real mix.
Multiply tint blend amount or additive gain, masked by ReflectionMask R and LayerMask B.

RGB multiplies the sampled MatCap color; default white. A (clamped 0..1, default 1) fades the entire MatCap effect back to no MatCap, independently of the existing intensity saturation and Multiply/Add mix. A=0 disables both contributions; it never changes mesh coverage, transparency, clipping, shadow casting, probes, direct specular or Clearcoat. Black RGB can darken Multiply and is not an off switch. Texture alpha remains unused.
Explicit MatCap mip level. Requires an imported mip chain to blur.

0 Geometry ignores both MatCap normal influences. 1 MainNormal applies MatCapNormalInfluence but ignores detail. 2 CombinedNormal applies main/detail influences independently. Defaults 1/1 reproduce the original selected source. Only MatCap changes; no scene reflection or direct-highlight modification.
Independent artistic rim tint.
Artistic rim gain, masked by LayerMask G. 0 disables Rim.
Main-shadow influence on Rim. Not additional-light shadowing.
Facing-angle extent of the rim. Independent of environment Fresnel.
Softness of the rim boundary.
0 view-only rim; 1 gates it by main-light geometric facing.
Linear R outline-width multiplier, vertex sampled.
Enable inverted-hull outline, following surface coverage. Layer debug views hide it. A transparent shell can reveal its rear outline through the body; default off.
Outline color.
Screen-space pixel-like width or world-space expansion using the shader scale convention.
1 screen-space width; 0 world-space expansion along normalized world normals.
Outline depth adjustment; positive moves away from the camera, accounting for reversed Z.
0 mesh normal; 1 normalized raw object-space normal in UV4.xyz. A zero UV4 vector falls back to mesh normal.
RGB emission mask, multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity.
Emission tint, composed after the lighting layers.
Emission gain. 0 disables emission texture sampling.
1 multiplies emission by the evaluated base color; 0 leaves emission independent.
0 final; 1 body; 2 direct specular; 3 environment; 4 MatCap; 5 Rim; 6 emission. Fog and outline are hidden in layer views.
Global coverage multiplier, not glass transmission. All light and art layers fade together. Zero discards color, outline, depth and shadows.
5 = Straight (default), 1 = Premultiplied output. Use only these two values. Both accept straight RGB source textures and give equivalent compositing. This is not black-background removal.
1 enables global Cutoff for all passes. 0 retains continuous alpha, but exactly zero coverage is still discarded.

Color-pass depth write only; default 0. At 1, DepthShadowCutoff also clips body, additional lights and outline. For a separate depth threshold use DepthPrepass=1 with this option=0. Enabling both retains this stricter color clipping. Does not guarantee DOF camera-depth inclusion.

Default 0. At 1, write the nearest qualifying surface depth before Outline and color, using global Cutoff and DepthShadowCutoff. Keep AlphaOptionZWrite=0 to retain color below the depth threshold. This can suppress rear self-overlap, not sort it. Off discards the depth pass before texture reads but does not remove its draw submission. Does not guarantee DOF camera-depth inclusion.
Minimum final coverage for depth writes and cutout shadows. Global Cutoff is applied first. Depth and shadow share this threshold; this is binary shadow coverage, not partial light transmission.
1 casts binary coverage-clipped shadows, using DepthShadowCutoff. 0 disables this material's ShadowCaster without disabling received shadows.
Neutral dielectric surface layer. Zero bypasses coating and preserves the original X lighting. Does not change alpha or stencil.
Perceptual coat roughness, independent of the substrate. Multiplied by coat-map G; floored at 0.04 and specular-filtered.
Coat reflection and layer-energy IOR only. 1 removes coat reflection. EyeX interior rays and dispersion use independent EyeRefractionIOR.
Linear data: R weight, G roughness multiplier; B/A ignored. Independent ST; shares MainTex filtering/wrap sampler state. White is neutral.
0 interpolated mesh normal; 1 main normal; 2 main plus detail; 3 independent coat normal. EyeX resolves this in the unwarped surface domain.
Unity tangent-space normal map, independent ST; shares NormalMap sampler state. Used only with normal source 3.
Strength of the independent coat normal. Does not modify substrate detail.
Coat reflection-probe strength. Independent of substrate ReflectionMode, reflection masks and environment tint.
Additional coat attenuation of diffuse body. 0 preserves Toon body brightness; 1 uses the layered approximation. Substrate specular attenuation is always applied.
0 final; 1 coat direct (Base+Add); 2 coat environment (Base only); 3 surface normal; 4 coat weight; 5 indirect body retention. Overrides Lighting Debug.
Shader.Category: Optional independent dielectric surface layer; defaults off.
Shader.Property: KKS five-region RGB encoding. UV0 with its own ST, linear clamp sampler. Not tiled with Texture2/3. Used only in KKS Regions mode.
KKS two-stage pattern: R appears over amount 0..1; G is added over 1..2 by max union. Both stages use cutoff and softness before region amounts. Linear data, repeat/trilinear/aniso8 sampling.

Tangent normal, not height. Raw AG: X=A,Y=G numerical GPU samples. Exported AG PNG: inverse-sRGB G only, requires data sampling (sRGB off). Unity Normal: use an imported normal map. Own ST after LiquidTiling. Repeat/trilinear/aniso8.
XY is UV offset; ZW is tiling. Applied before each pattern, normal and custom coverage texture ST. KKS region mask keeps untiled UV0.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the R-max(G,B) front-top region.
Game liquid amount 0..2 in the G-max(R,B) front-bottom region.

Game liquid amount 0..2 in the (min(G,B)-0.1)/0.9 face region.
Pigment RGB and opacity A. A=0 is a transparent wet film, not a disabled liquid layer. Pigment alpha never fades the wet normal or specular reflection and never cuts the mesh.
Pigment opacity multiplier. Combined with Color A inside the unified liquid coverage; zero preserves the substrate color and Toon lighting.
Scales decoded tangent slopes, then normalizes and smoothly limits tilt. It does not scale XY before reconstructing Z. Zero gives an unperturbed liquid surface over the substrate main normal.

Master strength for the entire liquid layer: coverage, pigment, normals and interface response. Zero leaves the dry material. Under wet coverage the liquid replaces the common Clearcoat interface, never stacks a second coat.

Main normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. 0 uses the mesh normal for this input; detail remains independently adjustable. Does not reduce specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid normals. Default 1. UseRamp=0 retains continuous lighting.

Detail normal-map influence on direct Toon diffuse only. Independent of ToonNormalInfluence; default 1. Specular, environment and Clearcoat keep full normals. SkinX uses its existing SkinDiffuseNormalDetail instead.

Pixel-derivative filtering strength for procedural Toon bands and the diffuse geometric horizon. Default 1; 0 disables this extra AA, not texture filtering. Does not blur textures or remove large normal/compression blocks. Texture ramps retain their own sampler filtering.

Renamed from ToonDarkFillColor; the optional colored-fill calculation is unchanged. RGB multiplies albedo; A is strength, default 0, not coverage. Still respects physical cast shadows. Use ToonMinLighting, not this color, to lift self-shadowed areas. Base-only, main-light-driven, off with UseRamp=0. Old game-card values under ToonDarkFillColor must be reapplied to this new property; no runtime migration plugin is included.

Minimum normalized main-light Toon diffuse response after the diffuse horizon and cast shadows: u becomes m+(1-m)*u. Default 0.15 provides a gentle shadow lift. Set 0 to disable; explicitly saved material values are preserved. Lifts both self and external shadows, not final RGB or GI; albedo, main light intensity/color, distance/cookie and material layer attenuation still apply. Base-only, no repeated Add lift, disabled with UseRamp=0. Does not change specular/coat/reflection lobes. Set ToonShadeColor A=0 when tuning this control alone.

Main-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights in Base/Add. Default 1 preserves the previous result; 0 flattens only this input, leaving detail independent. Selected-normal AA and light-facing guard follow this normal. Does not change diffuse, probes, MatCap, Clearcoat or liquid. Reuses existing samples.

Detail-normal influence on dry direct GGX and Toon highlights, independent of the main normal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 removes detail from this layer only. Global NormalMapScale/DetailNormalMapScale still set source strengths. EyeX follows refracted iris normal samples; AA uses the pre-refraction surface footprint.

Main-normal influence on MatCap only, default 1. MatCapNormalSource remains authoritative: Geometry ignores both influences; MainNormal ignores detail; CombinedNormal uses both. Zero removes only the main-map input, not the independently enabled detail. Shared by additive and diffuse-multiplicative MatCap; no new texture fetch.

Independent detail-normal influence on MatCap when MatCapNormalSource=CombinedNormal. Default 1 preserves existing materials; 0 keeps the selected main normal only. Ignored for Geometry/MainNormal sources. Does not affect direct specular, environment, Clearcoat or liquid; EyeX uses refracted samples.

0 fixed density; 1 screen-edge adaptive density, limited by TessellationFactor. Shared edges use endpoint positions only. No view-frustum/backface patch culling, so off-camera cast shadows are retained. This shader always has Hull/Domain stages; choose the ordinary shader to remove tessellation cost.

Maximum edge factor, clamped to 1..16. Default 4. Fixed mode uses this factor directly; ScreenEdge mode caps its pixel-length result. 1 does not disable the Hull/Domain stages. ForwardAdd repeats geometry work for each per-pixel light.

Desired screen-space edge length in pixels, 4..64, default 16. Only ScreenEdge mode. Lower values request denser geometry up to TessellationFactor. Adjacent patches agree on shared edges. Shadow-camera density may differ while using the same surface equation.

Independent Phong surface smoothing, default 0. Does not read the height map. GeometryMask R modulates it when enabled. It is not subdivision-surface reconstruction; hard-normal/UV seams or separate neck meshes require authored protection. Set 0 to preserve the original piecewise-linear surface.

Default off avoids geometry-mask fetches. Enable an independent linear UV0 RG mask: R Phong smoothing, G displacement. White allows the effect, black retains the source surface. It does not change diffuse, skin DetailMask semantics or mesh clipping.

Linear data, sRGB off. R smoothing and G displacement; B/A unused. Independent UV0 ST. Match values at welded UV edges, and fade R/G at neck joins or hard-normal boundaries. Not the KKS DetailMask, not a normal map. Uses Geometry Map Mip Level.

Linear R height, sRGB off, with independent UV0 ST. Height 0..1 is clamped; 0.5 is neutral at default midlevel. Carrier explicitly binds exact float neutral data. Alpha unused; GeometryMask G controls coverage. Does not reinterpret normal maps, liquid textures or eye parallax.

Signed world-space amplitude in Unity units, clamped to -0.05..0.05, default 0. Offset=(R-midlevel)*strength*GeometryMask.G along the interpolated world normal. Zero skips height sampling and normal reconstruction. No collider or CPU mesh-vertex deformation; bounds need the optional helper when expanding.

Zero-height reference, 0..1, default 0.5. Below it moves inward and above it outward for positive strength; negative strength reverses polarity. White therefore moves by (1-midlevel)*strength, not the full strength at default 0.5.

Explicit mip level, 0..8, used for height and geometry masks in Domain stages. Larger values smooth fine data; a mip chain is required. No automatic pixel derivatives or height-field ray search. Default 0.

Height-gradient correction of the interpolated shading normal/tangent, 0..1, default 1. Uses barycentric metric finite differences, including height/mask ST and world scale; zero preserves the source normal. Intended for shallow surfaces, not overhangs or physically exact large-deformation transport. Specular/MatCap controls still act on their own normal-map inputs.

Additional conservative world-space padding, 0..0.1, default 0. Used by optional TomTessellation.dll/component, not by GPU displacement. The helper also adds bounds for the actual smoothing/height controls, restores owned state on disable, and does not modify original shared meshes. Without it, Unity may cull shader-expanded surfaces using their original bounds.
Shader.Category: Independent linear RG geometry weights. Protect seams and separate mesh joins explicitly; no automatic vertex welding or changes to KKS mask meanings.
Shallow signed world-space height displacement in all geometry passes. Linear R data, explicit midlevel/mip, and independent normal correction.
Optional D3D11 geometric refinement. A separate shader entry preserves ordinary-shader draw cost. Density, Phong smoothing and height displacement are independent.
Optional CPU culling-bounds protection. The shader alone cannot change Unity Renderer bounds; no collision deformation.
